text: Jordan finally performed "Fast Car" at The Lantern's open mic, nearly backing out beforehand but getting there thanks to Mika, with Dev already waiting at a table. The performance was imperfect—shaky start, a rough bridge—but Jordan settled into it and finished to applause, feeling proud and exhilarated afterward. Watching Dev and Mika hit it off, then spending two easy, warm hours together afterward, left Jordan wanting more nights exactly like this one.
